releaseNotes: NEW: ACCOUNT SWITCHER INSIDE CLONES — every clone now gets a second home-screen icon (⚡ Switch). Open it, tap CAPTURE CURRENT ACCOUNT to save a login, then switch between saved logins instantly. ONE clone, MANY accounts, no more extra downloads for more accounts.
NEW: QUICK SWITCH NOTIFICATION — a persistent notification with one-tap buttons for your clones. Pull the shade anywhere, tap a clone, you're in. Toggle it on the home screen.

How the switcher works (honest version): it snapshots the clone's saved login state and restores it on switch — the same trick power users do manually, automated. Discord's own login/session data stays on Discord's servers; nothing is shared or uploaded.
The account switcher is ON by default for new clones (switch it off in the options before creating). Old clones: tap the update (↻) button on their card to rebuild them with the switcher.
Full self-check in CI now also verifies the injected switcher on every build.
